items.title: Data governance with annotations in Amazon S3
items.summary: Attach governance context such as classification, retention, residency, and PII flags directly to your Amazon S3 objects with S3 annotations. This post walks through the end-to-end pattern and the handful of S3 behaviors that decide whether your governance design is correct.
items.creator: Aditya Jain

items.title: Recommended resilience testing in the next generation of AWS Resilience Hub
items.summary: The next generation of AWS Resilience Hub introduces recommended resilience testing: four pre-configured, AWS FIS-powered tests that validate how your service detects and recovers from failures across Availability Zones, dependencies, and Regions, turning your resilience policy into evidence-backed pass or fail results.
items.creator: Jennifer Moran
